maintenance.change: Built: 36 variants; the variant grid widened so that the file column (with its meta) does not overlap the print column.

Rebuilt at the Figma parity review (user: configure the link by variants, not by modes; no secondary or tertiary context). The set 225:276 (Tone × Destination × State, 36 variants), its specification 228:63 and the collections Components · link text and Components · link context are removed. New set 232:659 (Color × Size × State, 54 variants) whose variants set the modes of the new collections Components · link size and Components · link color themselves; the destination moves into the nested part _Link/Destination 232:442 (Destination, Meta, Indicator icon); specification 234:13. Page backdrop 237:400 behind the on inverse rows. Parity re-measured: 4680 records, 0 failures.

Anatomy board 234:69 (user review): the focus ring is drawn dashed at 50 % opacity so the link no longer reads as a boxed control, callout 1 points at the label, and legend item 4 says the ring appears only on keyboard focus.

Icon slot (authoring/adapters/figma/icon-slot-migrate.plugin.js): the nested Icon md instances of the part (exposed in the file variant, showing Size) are replaced by the Phosphor glyphs themselves, same bindings; only the file destination binds its glyph to the new instance-swap property File icon#259:0. User decision at the wave 1 Figma parity review (2026-10-26): a component imposes the size of its icon, so the designer chooses the glyph only; an exposed nested Icon showed its Size property. Specification instances keep their file glyphs (3 re-applied); parity re-measured, the 18 hashes equal; specification pixel-identical before the text change.

Library pages (user decision): the master and its internal parts moved to the section Link of the Actions library page (IDs kept, instances linked; library-pages.plugin.js); the component page keeps the specification, which now links to the section (spec-master-links.plugin.js).

Library page layout (user request): the Actions page opens with the overview frame (369:743: description, isometric cover, a card per component); the section Link starts with a Section header (369:2193: summary, specification link, properties) and the master sits under it, its internal parts on its right (_Link/Destination packed into a tight grid, variant order kept) (family-pages.plugin.js; IDs of the masters unchanged). The specification's link to the master moved to the top right of the title row (367:14; spec-header-links.plugin.js, replacing spec-master-links.plugin.js); Documentation and Contract links follow at the first publication.
